Hi Monica —

Thanks for sending this over. We’re happy in principle to be featured and to provide the logo. A couple of small notes from our side / legal: 

- Please shorten the quote on p.1 to remove the numeric percentage (we prefer qualitative phrasing: "significant throughput improvement")
- Use the full-color horizontal logo on the PDF; for social, use the monochrome variant
- We prefer that the customer metrics paragraph remain generic (no exact customer counts) — can you remove the line that references "300 production nodes"

I’ve attached a signed scan of our consent form (Stratus_CaseStudy_Consent_Scanned.pdf) to indicate approval of the draft subject to the edits above. Our legal team (cc'd) asked that you send a final PDF with the requested edits highlighted before we post.

Happy to approve once the edits are applied — thanks for coordinating.
